diff_hunk: @@ -88466,6 +88468,10 @@ interface Location { // but see also
body:
The following paragraph places authoring conformance requirements to disallow redundant values:

> The allow-top-navigation and allow-top-navigation-by-user-activation keywords must not both be specified, as doing so is redundant; only allow-top-navigation will have an effect in such non-conformant markup. 

I think we should similarly prohibit allow-custom-protocols if either allow-top-navigation or allow-popups is specified, since it is redundant.

(Note, this has no impact on implementation; it is just advice for authors.)
